title: Reject impossible equipment qualification dates
prompt:
Fix calendar validation in lib/ohworks-equipment-qualification.ts. Lines 213-214 accept rolled-over Date.parse values; the run, installation, operational, performance, and change-event checks at lines 317, 327, 337, 352, and 365 all reuse that predicate. Verified reproduction: installation January 1, operational January 2, performance 2026-02-30T00:00:00Z, valid existing approver roles, interval 365 days, and run March 3 returns qualified/fully-qualified. An impossible performance date therefore passes the qualification chain. The facility readiness view imports this evaluator at lib/ohworks-demo-facility-readiness-view.ts:12-16 and is rendered by app/pilot/ohworks/page.tsx:216.

Replace only the local UTC timestamp predicate with literal calendar/clock validation before parsing. Cover month lengths and leap years while preserving valid Z timestamps with optional fractional seconds. Each invalid position must keep its existing specific timestamp-invalid reason and not_qualified decision. Preserve stage ordering, approver-role rules, change-event semantics, and requalification intervals; this task changes timestamp validation only.

Add tests/ohworks/equipment-qualification-calendar-dates.test.ts with an otherwise valid ordered chain and independently invalid run, installation, operational, performance, and change-event dates. Include February 30, April 31, non-leap February 29, and valid leap-day controls. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/equipment-qualification-calendar-dates.test.ts tests/ohworks/equipment-qualification.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-facility-readiness-view.test.ts. Assert exact reasons and unchanged valid decisions. Use fabricated records; work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only the named production file and new test. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, auth changes, commits, or pushes.
